_doc: DeepLabCut-Live head preview settings (docs/decisions/0224). python = the dlclivegui env's interpreter (the helper runs there, not in drieu_t_maze); model_path is relative to host/ unless absolute; port is on 127.0.0.1 only; cpu_threads caps the helper's CPU threads (2 measured best: faster model and less load on the tracker than the default).
